source_read: https://shahshalalfood.co.uk/our-menu/<slug>/ product pages + /menu/ + /allergen-infromation/ (all 31 product pages downloaded afresh 2026-10-08 via the script's polite fetcher, robots.txt honoured; panels read by an independent text parse of the HTML and 4 panels rendered in Chromium)
notes: All 10 published items match the page's per-serving Nutrition Summary on every column (kcal, protein, carbs, fat, sat fat, sugars, fibre, sodium, trans fat); the 7 existing hold-backs re-confirmed from the pages (4 platters whose own macros are 15-22% above their calories, Kofta/Fish Gyro with two different calorie figures, Chicken Nuggets all '~'); fresh download re-run reproduces data/source exactly. Allergens are link-only (the allergen matrix disagrees with the product pages' own ingredient allergen lines), so no allergen marks are published to check; contains_beef/vegetarian tags match the home-page '(Contains Beef)' marks and 'all vegetarian' description.
